bio.text: John Moolenaar represents Michigan's 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and is a member of the House Committee on Appropriations.
He began his career as a chemist after earning a bachelor's degree in chemistry from Hope College, and later worked in business development and as a school administrator.
He holds a master's degree in public administration from Harvard University.
He served in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2003 to 2008 and in the Michigan State Senate from 2011 to 2014.
